subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a programming language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Linux**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Linux** is an open-source operating system kernel, not a programming language.
 
• It was created by **Linus Torvalds** in 1991.
 
• Linux is used in a wide variety of systems including **servers, desktops, and mobile devices**.
 
• It supports numerous programming languages but itself is not a programming language.
 
• Popular Linux distributions include **Ubuntu, Fedora, and CentOS**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **C#**

 
 
• A modern, object-oriented programming language developed by **Microsoft**.
 
• It is used for developing a wide range of applications that run on the .NET Framework.
 
• Commonly used in **web development, desktop applications, and game development** (with Unity).
 
 
 
• **Python**
 
 
• A high-level, interpreted programming language known for its readability and versatility.
 
• Widely used in **web development, data science, artificial intelligence, and automation**.
 
• Features a large standard library and supports multiple programming paradigms.
 
 
 
• **Java**
 
 
• A high-level, class-based, object-oriented programming language designed to have as few implementation dependencies as possible.
 
• Used in **web applications, Android app development, and enterprise-level applications**.
 
• Known for its portability across platforms via the Java Virtual Machine (JVM).
